traits.title: Traits & Proficiencies
sheet.noSkills: No skills tied to this ability.
settings.layoutHint: How the Character Sheet arranges its stats. Saved per character in this browser — every player picks their own favorite look for each sheet.
settings.printDesc: Open a printable copy of the sheet — send it to paper or Save as PDF.
settings.exportDesc: Download this character’s sheet data as a JSON file (backup or transfer).
settings.importDesc: Validate and preview a character JSON file before replacing this sheet.
settings.layoutClassicDesc: Every stat as a tile in the vitals band: Passive Perception, Save DC and Spell Attack beside HP and AC.
settings.layoutCompactDesc: Derived stats dock onto their ability cards: Initiative on Dexterity, passive Perception on Wisdom, Save DC and Spell Attack on the casting ability.
combat.title: Attacks
combat.noWeapons: No weapons readied. Add weapons in the Backpack and mark them Equipped or Ready to see attacks here.
combat.noPrepared: No cantrips or prepared spells yet — prepare them in the Spellbook.
tracker.title: Trackers
tracker.name: Rage, Ki, Slots…
tracker.hint: Count limited resources — Rage, Ki, spell slots, hit dice. ± adjusts during play.
tracker.engineEmpty: No limited-use resources from this build.
rest.title: Take a rest
rest.hitDiceHint: Spend a Hit Die to heal by its average (+ CON). Prefer to roll? Spend it on the Hit Dice tracker and add your roll with HP ±.
rest.longSummary: Long rest → HP to full, all spent Hit Dice regained, and every resource resets by its rule.
spellbook.empty: No spells yet. Add one with ＋ above.
spellbook.name: Spell name
backpack.name: Item name
additem.title: Add to Backpack
additem.cartEmpty: Nothing selected yet — browse or search, then Add.
additem.noBook: Install a rulebook data addon (e.g. the D&D 5.5e Compendium) to browse items. You can still add a custom item below.
spell.swapNone: No spell available to swap here yet.
spell.available: Available — drag into a slot (or click)
spell.dragHint: Drag into a slot above, or click to add
spell.spellbookEmpty: No spells learned yet — add some from the list below.
spell.learnAvail: Learn a spell — drag into the book (or click)
spell.overLimit: Over the prepared limit — unprepare one.
spell.snapshot: From the last engine-computed loadout (kept when the rulebook addon is removed)
spell.copyHdr: Copy a spell into your {cls} spellbook
spell.noMatchingScroll: No scroll of this spell in the inventory — copying from a borrowed book.
spell.copyCost: Costs 50 gp per spell level. You have {gp} gp.
spell.copyAllKnown: Every spell you can copy is already in your book.
spell.otherTitle: Add a spell from another source
spell.otherHint: From a feat, magic item, or homebrew.
spell.castWithSlotsHint: A spellcaster can cast this using spell slots (2024), on top of any free/limited use.
builder.soon: The guided Builder appears here when the rules engine and compendium addons are installed.
builder.levelAria: Level {n} — expand or collapse its choices
builder.noExtraFeats: Feats from a boon, magic item, or homebrew source — none yet.
builder.baseHint: Enter base scores; the engine adds background / feat increases (capped at 20; an Epic Boon can push a score to 30).
builder.pointBuyHint: Point buy — 27 points, each base score 8–15. Species / background / feat increases are added on top.
builder.epicBoonHint: Level 19 grants an Epic Boon: pick an Epic Boon feat, or any other feat you qualify for — an Ability Score Improvement is a feat too (2024). A boon’s +1 can raise a score above 20 (max 30).
override.edit: Set a manual value (overrides the computed one)
data.importHint: Choose or paste an exported character. Nothing changes until you review and confirm the preview.
data.importOverwriteWarning: Confirming replaces this sheet’s D&D data. The host character, lore, portrait, and relationships are unchanged.
data.importError.empty: Choose a JSON file or paste JSON first.
data.importError.size: The import is larger than the 1 MB sheet limit.
data.importError.read: The selected file could not be read.
data.importError.json: The import is not valid JSON.
data.importError.shape: The JSON does not match the character-sheet format.
data.importError.unsafe: The JSON contains a forbidden object key.
data.importError.limit: The import contains too many values.
data.importError.depth: The import is nested too deeply.
data.importError.format: This JSON belongs to a different application or add-on.
data.importError.version: This character-sheet export version is not supported.
legend.saveDesc: Resist an effect (spell, poison, hazard…) that targets your {a}.
legend.fAc: best armor / Unarmored base + shield + bonuses
legend.fHp: hit die (max at L1, average after) + CON per level + bonuses
abilityDesc.STR: Physical power — melee attacks, Athletics, lifting and breaking.
abilityDesc.DEX: Agility & reflexes — finesse/ranged attacks, AC, Initiative, Stealth.
abilityDesc.CON: Health & stamina — Hit Points and Concentration saves.
abilityDesc.INT: Reason & memory — Arcana, Investigation and lore.
abilityDesc.WIS: Awareness & insight — Perception, Insight and willpower.
abilityDesc.CHA: Force of personality — social skills and many spells.
skillDesc.acrobatics: Balance, tumble and keep your footing.
skillDesc.arcana: Recall lore about magic, the planes and arcane symbols.
skillDesc.history: Recall past events, people, places and wars.
skillDesc.insight: Read intentions and sense a lie.
skillDesc.intimidation: Sway others through threats and force of will.
skillDesc.investigation: Deduce, search for clues and reason things out.
skillDesc.medicine: Stabilize the dying and diagnose ailments.
skillDesc.nature: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals and weather.
skillDesc.perception: Notice what is around you — sight, sound and smell.
skillDesc.performance: Delight an audience with music, dance or oratory.
skillDesc.persuasion: Influence others with tact, grace and good faith.
skillDesc.religion: Recall lore about gods, rites and the divine.
skillDesc.sleightOfHand: Pick pockets, palm objects and other manual trickery.
skillDesc.survival: Track, forage, navigate and read the wilds.
statDesc.ac: How hard you are to hit in combat.
statDesc.init: Your place in the turn order when combat starts.
statDesc.pb: Added to attacks, saves and skills you are proficient in.
statDesc.speed: How far you can move on your turn.
statDesc.passive: What you notice without actively searching (no roll).
statDesc.hp: The damage you can take before you start dying.
statDesc.spellDC: The number a target must beat to resist your {a}-based spells.
statDesc.spellAtk: Added to your spell attack rolls to hit a target.

rules.connected.one: Rulebook data connected — {n} class available. The Builder and auto-computed stats are active.
rules.connected.other: Rulebook data connected — {n} classes available. The Builder and auto-computed stats are active.

rules.disconnected: No rulebook addon installed — the sheet is fully hand-fillable. Install a rulebook data addon (e.g. the D&D 5.5e Compendium) to unlock the Builder and auto-computed stats.
rules.reconcileManual: Values that were previously computed changed while this sheet was manual. Choose which source should remain authoritative; nothing is overwritten until you decide.
rules.reconcileEdition: This sheet was last computed with a different ruleset. Choose whether to keep the current manual values or recompute from the installed rulebook.
rules.manualMode: This character is intentionally using the hand-filled sheet. The installed rulebook remains available to other characters.
